subject: Guest package manager (bpm): live VirtualBuddy acceptance of signed .bpm package install/verify/remove with serial and file:// repo transports
host: M3 Max, macOS 27.2 (26B5101f), VirtualBuddy 2.1 generic EFI profile via vm/virtualbuddy_console_probe.swift (freshly rebuilt this run)

design_decision.choice: Repo-native guest tool bpm (vm/commands/bpm/bpm.c) + host tool scripts/release/package.py
design_decision.evaluation: opkg, dpkg, and pkgsrc pkg_install were evaluated and rejected: all require compression libraries (gzip/xz/bzip2 via zlib/libarchive) absent from the libSystem-only guest runtime; dpkg additionally requires Perl and maintainer-script shells, pkgsrc requires OpenSSL for signatures, opkg's useful configurations require libcurl/wget. Porting those stacks exceeds a purpose-built tool and contradicts the minimal server-image profile. bpm reuses the repository's exact Ed25519 trust-root and signed-manifest scheme (scripts/release/signing.py), so host and guest verify the same bytes with the same policy.
design_decision.format: Uncompressed ustar .bpm: manifest.json (name, version, depends, recipe {path, sha256} binding packages/*.json, files[] {path, sha256, size, mode}) + manifest.json.sig (RFC 8032 over the canonical signing payload) + payload/<path> members. Guest verifies signature, manifest digest, then every payload hash before writing anything.

image.kernel_note: Same kernel collection and folded loader as evidence/virtualization/virtualbuddy-console/live (unchanged; no loader work in this task)
image.layers: composed-login (runtime + vim-inclusive command toolkit + console-login) + bpm-run-2 (/usr/bin/bpm, libSystem-only, otool-verified) + staged package repo layer

honest_limitations: No upgrades, dependency solving, or package scripts; install refuses existing files by design
Key rotation reaches the guest only via a newly baked trust root image layer
Serial transport throughput limits practical transfers to tens of KB; SFTP remains the transport on the SSH profile (not available under stock VirtualBuddy 2.1, which omits the virtio entropy device)
These are VM results on VirtualBuddy's generic EFI platform; physical Apple Silicon Gate 2 is not run
